description: Bulk-migrate every view in a source schema to a target with optional substitutions. Emits a per-view status DataFrame for the migration completion report.

inputs.description: Reads every view's DDL from source

outputs.description: Status DataFrame: schema_name, view_name, target_view, status, error_message, ddl_chars

source_connection_env_var.description: Env var with source SQLAlchemy URL. Set this OR source_connection.
source_connection_env_var.label: Source Connection Env Var

target_connection_env_var.description: Env var with target SQLAlchemy URL. Set this OR target_connection.
target_connection_env_var.label: Target Connection Env Var

schemas.description: Source schemas to scan (default: all non-system schemas)
schemas.label: Source Schemas

include_patterns.description: fnmatch-style glob patterns (case-insensitive) against qualified view names. Examples: ['APP.V_*'], ['HR.V_EMPLOYEES', 'FINANCE.V_*']. Default: include all discovered views.
include_patterns.label: Include Patterns

exclude_patterns.description: fnmatch-style glob patterns to exclude. Applied AFTER include_patterns. Examples: ['*_LEGACY', 'APP.V_ORACLE_*'] for views you've rewritten by hand.
exclude_patterns.label: Exclude Patterns

target_schema.description: Override target schema name. If unset, uses source schema name verbatim. e.g. 'RAW' → all views land in RAW.<view_name>.
target_schema.label: Target Schema Override

table_replacements.description: Substitutions applied to every view's DDL — old qualified name → new
table_replacements.label: Table Replacements

function_replacements.description: Dialect function substitutions applied case-insensitive whole-word
function_replacements.label: Function Replacements

view_ddl_overrides.label: Per-View Body Overrides
view_ddl_overrides.description: Source qualified name → SELECT body (no CREATE VIEW). For views the auto-rewrite can't handle (Oracle CONNECT BY, MSSQL CROSS APPLY, etc.)

dry_run.label: Dry Run
dry_run.description: Try every CREATE VIEW in a transaction then ROLLBACK — no state change.

fail_on_any_error.description: If true, the asset materialization fails when ANY view fails to migrate. Default: succeed and report failures in the status DataFrame.
fail_on_any_error.label: Fail On Any Error

name: Database Views Migration
